enriquez-2005.citation: Enriquez, Shapiro, Souza and Zatsepin (2005), Ocean Dynamics 55, 476-489.

records.source_locator: Table 4, Sevastopol row, printed page 485 / PDF page 10; section 4 model context.
records.scope: Reported Sevastopol structure in the fine-grid simulation analyzed for May-June 2000.
records.qualification: Model-case reference, not a dated observed eddy or regional constant. The table does not supply horizontal size, measurement uncertainty or a physical footprint. Penetration depth is not lens thickness or water-column depth.
records.definition: Approximate vertical reach of the modeled eddy circulation, as reported in the penetration-depth column.

records.definition: Reported persistence of one modeled Caucasus eddy occurrence.
records.scope: One of three separate occurrences in the May-June 2000 simulation.
records.qualification: Model event, not a measured physical lifespan, regional mean or recurrence rate. The three durations stay separate; no start/end dates or annual frequency inferred. Source notes shape and stability depend on the Rim Current position.
records.period_label: May-June 2000 simulation; individual event dates unspecified
